01

“There has already been for you an excellent example in Abraham and…”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 60:4).

01
Explanation from Mujāhid 01

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
ʿAbd al-Raḥmān informed us, he said: Ibrāhīm narrated to us, he said: Ādam narrated to us, he said: Waraqāʾ narrated to us, from Ibn Abī Najīḥ, from Mujāhid, on His saying, ﷻ:
There has already been for you an excellent example in Abraham and those with him [al-Mumtaḥina: 4], except for the saying of Abraham [al-Mumtaḥina: 4], he said: "They were forbidden to take as an example Abraham's seeking forgiveness for his father, so that they would seek forgiveness for the polytheists."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ عز وجل:
قَدْ كَانَتْ لَكُمْ أُسْوَةٌ حَسَنَةٌ فِي إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَالَّذِينَ مَعَهُ [الممتحنة: 4] إِلَّا قَوْلَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ [الممتحنة: 4] قَالَ: «نُهُوا أَنْ يَتَأَسَّوْا بِاسْتِغْفَارِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ لِأَبِيهِ فَيَسْتَغْفِرُوا لِلْمُشْرِكِينَ»

02

“Our Lord, make us not a trial for those who disbelieve”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 60:5).

02
Explanation from Mujāhid 02

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
ʿAbd al-Raḥmān informed us, he said: Ibrāhīm narrated to us, he said: Ādam narrated to us, he said: Waraqāʾ narrated to us, from Ibn Abī Najīḥ, from Mujāhid:
Our Lord, make us not a trial for those who disbelieve [al-Mumtaḥina: 5], he says: "Our Lord, do not punish us at their hands, nor with a punishment from Yourself, so that they say: Had these been upon the truth, this would not have befallen them, and we would not have been given power over them."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ،
رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا فِتْنَةً لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا [الممتحنة: 5] يَقُولُ: " رَبَّنَا لَا تُعَذِّبْنَا بِأَيْدِيهِمْ وَلَا بِعَذَابٍ مِنْ عِنْدِكَ، فَيَقُولُوا: لَوْ كَانَ هَؤُلَاءِ عَلَى حَقٍّ مَا أَصَابَهُمْ هَذَا وَمَا سُلِّطْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ "

03

“God does not forbid you from those who do not fight you because of…”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 60:8).

03
Explanation from Mujāhid 03

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
ʿAbd al-Raḥmān informed us, he said: Ibrāhīm narrated to us, he said: Ādam narrated to us, he said: Waraqāʾ narrated to us, from Ibn Abī Najīḥ, from Mujāhid:
God does not forbid you from those who do not fight you because of religion [al-Mumtaḥina: 8], he says: "that you seek forgiveness for them, and treat them with kindness, and deal justly with them; and they are those who believed in Mecca and did not emigrate."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
لَا يَنْهَاكُمُ اللَّهُ عَنِ الَّذِينَ لَمْ يُقَاتِلُوكُمْ فِي الدِّينِ [الممتحنة: 8] يَقُولُ: «أَنْ تَسْتَغْفِرُوا لَهُمْ وَتَبَرُّوهُمْ وَتُقْسِطُوا إِلَيْهِمْ، وَهُمُ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا بِمَكَّةَ وَلَمْ يُهَاجِرُوا»
Edition record 373599 · p. 655Link to report ↗

“God only forbids you from those who fight you because of religion”

An explanation (Q 60:9).

Report 04

Report 04

English
And by it [the same chain], from Mujāhid: God only forbids you from those who fight you because of religion [al-Mumtaḥina: 9], he said: "They are the disbelievers of Quraysh."

وَبِهِ عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، إِنَّمَا يَنْهَاكُمُ اللَّهُ عَنِ الَّذِينَ قَاتَلُوكُمْ فِي الدِّينِ [الممتحنة: 9] قَالَ: «هُمْ كُفَّارُ قُرَيْشٍ»

05

“then examine them”

Four explanations transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr and Umm ʿAṭiyya (Q 60:10, 60:11).

05
Explanation from Mujāhid 05

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
ʿAbd al-Raḥmān informed us, he said: Ibrāhīm narrated to us, he said: Ādam narrated to us, he said: Waraqāʾ narrated to us, from Ibn Abī Najīḥ, from Mujāhid, on His saying, ﷻ:
then examine them [al-Mumtaḥina: 10], he said: He says: Ask them what brought them [p. 656]. If anger at their husbands or resentment brought them and they have not believed, return them to their husbands; but if they came as believers in God, ﷻ, and His Messenger, keep them, and give their husbands, meaning their dowers, and marry them if you wish, and give them their dowers.
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ عز وجل:
فَامْتَحِنُوهُنَّ [الممتحنة: 10] قَالَ: يَقُولُ: سَلُوهُنَّ مَا جَاءَ ⦗ص: 656⦘ بِهِنَّ؟ فَإِنْ كَانَ جَاءَ بِهِنَّ غَضَبٌ عَلَى أَزْوَاجِهِنَّ أَوْ سَخَطٌ، وَلَمْ يُؤْمِنَّ فَأَرْجِعُوهُنَّ إِلَى أَزْوَاجِهِنَّ، وَإِنَّ جِئْنَ مُؤْمِنَاتٍ بِاللَّهِ عز وجل وَرَسُولِهِ فَأَمْسِكُوهُنَّ، وَآتُوا أَزْوَاجَهُنَّ، يَعْنِي صَدُقَاتِهِنَّ، وَانْكِحُوهُنَّ إِنْ شِئْتُمْ وَأَصْدِقُوهُنَّ "
Edition record 373601 · p. 655Link to report ↗
06
Explanation from Mujāhid 06

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
ʿAbd al-Raḥmān informed us, he said: Ibrāhīm narrated to us, he said: Ādam narrated to us, he said: Waraqāʾ narrated to us, from Ibn Abī Najīḥ, from Mujāhid:
and do not hold to the ties of the disbelieving women [al-Mumtaḥina: 10], he said: "The Companions of the Messenger of God ﷺ, were commanded to divorce their wives who were disbelievers in Mecca, who had stayed with the disbelievers in Mecca."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
وَلَا تُمْسِكُوا بِعِصَمِ الْكَوَافِرِ [الممتحنة: 10] قَالَ: «أُمِرَ أَصْحَابُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ بِطَلَاقِ نِسَائِهِمْ كُنَّ كَوَافِرَ بِمَكَّةَ قَعَدْنَ مَعَ الْكُفَّارِ بِمَكَّةَ»
Edition record 373602 · p. 656Link to report ↗
07
Explanation from Mujāhid 07

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
ʿAbd al-Raḥmān informed us, he said: Ibrāhīm narrated to us, he said: Ādam narrated to us, he said: Waraqāʾ narrated to us, from Ibn Abī Najīḥ, from Mujāhid:
And ask for what you spent, and let them ask for what they spent [al-Mumtaḥina: 10], he says: "Whichever of the wives of the Companions of the Prophet, ﷺ, went to the disbelievers, let the disbelievers give them [the husbands] the women's dowers, and let them keep them; and whichever of the wives of the disbelievers went to the Companions of the Prophet, ﷺ, let their husbands among the disbelievers be given their dowers, and let them [the Muslims] keep them. And this was under a treaty that existed between the Prophet, ﷺ, and Quraysh." Then He said: And if anything of your wives escapes from you to the disbelievers [al-Mumtaḥina: 11], "those with whom you have no covenant"; and you subsequently obtain [spoils] [al-Mumtaḥina: 11], he says: "you obtain booty from Quraysh or others"; then give those whose wives have gone the like of what they spent [al-Mumtaḥina: 11], meaning: "their dowers, as compensation."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
وَاسْأَلُوا مَا أَنْفَقْتُمْ وَلْيَسْأَلُوا مَا أَنْفَقُوا [الممتحنة: 10] يَقُولُ: " مَا ذَهَبَ مِنْ أَزْوَاجِ أَصْحَابِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ، إِلَى الْكُفَّارِ فَلْيُعْطِهِمُ الْكُفَّارُ صَدُقَاتِهِنَّ، وَلْيُمْسِكُوهُنَّ، وَمَا ذَهَبَ مِنْ أَزْوَاجِ الْكُفَّارِ إِلَى أَصْحَابِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ، فَلْيُعْطِ أَزْوَاجُهُنَّ مِنَ الْكُفَّارِ صَدُقَاتِهِنَّ، وَلْيُمْسِكُوهُنَّ، وَكَانَ هَذَا فِي صُلْحٍ كَانَ بَيْنَ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ وَبَيْنَ قُرَيْشٍ، ثُمَّ قَالَ: وَإِنْ فَاتَكُمْ شَيْءٌ مِنْ أَزْوَاجِكُمْ إِلَى الْكُفَّارِ [الممتحنة: 11] «الَّذِينَ لَيْسَ بَيْنَكُمْ وَبَيْنَهُمْ عَهْدٌ» ، فَعَاقَبْتُمْ [الممتحنة: 11] يَقُولُ: «أَصَبْتُمْ مَغْنَمًا مِنْ قُرَيْشٍ أَوْ غَيْرِهِمْ» ، فَآتُوا الَّذِينَ ذَهَبَتْ أَزْوَاجُهُمْ مِثْلَ مَا أَنْفَقُوا [الممتحنة: 11] ، يَعْنِي: «صَدُقَاتِهِنَّ عِوَضًا»
Edition record 373603 · p. 656Link to report ↗
08
Report from Umm ʿAṭiyya 08

Umm ʿAṭiyya

English
Transmission wording
ʿAbd al-Raḥmān informed us, he said: Ibrāhīm narrated to us, he said: Ādam narrated to us, he said: Ḥammād b. Salama narrated to us, from Hishām b. Ḥassān, from Muḥammad b. Sīrīn, from Umm ʿAṭiyya, who said:
"the Messenger of God ﷺ, took a pledge from [p. 657] the women that they would not wail. A woman said to the Messenger of God ﷺ: So-and-so helped me [in mourning]; may I not help her? So the Messenger of God ﷺ, withdrew his hand from it and did not take her pledge."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ حَسَّانَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ، عَنْ أُمِّ عَطِيَّةَ، قَالَتْ:
" أَخَذَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَلَى ⦗ص: 657⦘ النِّسَاءِ أَلَّا يَنُحْنَ، فَقَالَتِ امْرَأَةٌ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ: إِنَّ فُلَانَةَ أَسْعَدَتْنِي، أَفَلَا أُسْعِدُهَا؟ فَقَبَضَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَلَيْهِ يَدَهُ وَلَمْ يُبَايِعْهَا "

06

“and will not disobey you in what is right”

An explanation (Q 60:12).

09
Report 09

Report 09

English
Transmission wording
ʿAbd al-Raḥmān informed us, he said: Ibrāhīm narrated to us, he said: Ādam narrated to us, he said: Shaybān narrated to us, from Manṣūr, from Sālim b. Abī l-Jaʿd:
and will not disobey you in what is right [al-Mumtaḥina: 12], he said: "It is wailing; so the Messenger of God ﷺ, forbade them to wail."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا شَيْبَانُ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ:
وَلَا يَعْصِينَكَ فِي مَعْرُوفٍ [الممتحنة: 12] قَالَ: «هُوَ النَّوْحُ، فَنَهَاهُنَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنِ النَّوْحِ»

07

“They have despaired of the Hereafter”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 60:13).

10
Explanation from Mujāhid 10

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
ʿAbd al-Raḥmān informed us, he said: Ibrāhīm narrated to us, he said: Ādam narrated to us, he said: Waraqāʾ narrated to us, from Ibn Abī Najīḥ, from Mujāhid:
They have despaired of the Hereafter [al-Mumtaḥina: 13], meaning through their disbelief, as the disbelievers have despaired of the companions of the graves [al-Mumtaḥina: 13], he says: "as those of them who have died have despaired of the reward of the Hereafter and of the mercy of God, when their evil deeds were made clear to them."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
قَدْ يَئِسُوا مِنَ الْآخِرَةِ [الممتحنة: 13] يَعْنِي بِكُفْرِهِمْ، كَمَا يَئِسَ الْكُفَّارُ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ الْقُبُورِ [الممتحنة: 13] يَقُولُ: «كَمَا يَئِسَ مَنْ مَاتَ مِنْهُمْ مِنْ ثَوَابِ الْآخِرَةِ، وَمِنْ رَحْمَةِ اللَّهِ حِينَ بَيَّنَ لَهُمْ أَعْمَالَهُمُ الْخَبِيثَةَ»
Edition record 373606 · p. 657Link to report ↗
